title: News from JMonkeyEngine - 5 December 2021
content:
Thank you for your contributions to our project!

We're proud to announce the release of JMonkeyEngine 3.4.1, which patches a handful of bugs and performance issues discovered in the JME 3.4 libraries since they became generally available in May.

Alpha testing has begun on JME 3.5, which is planned for general availability in early 2022.

For the latest news and discussion of JMonkeyEngine software development,
visit the Development category at the JME Hub/Forum: https://hub.jmonkeyengine.org/c/development-discussion-jme3/9
